bibl.title: Database of Military Inscriptions and Papyri of Early Roman Palestine (DMIPERP).
bibl.seg: Christopher B. Zeichmann, Database of Military Inscriptions and Papyri of Early Roman Palestine (DMIPERP).
bibl.note: The project aims to help build a bridge between the fields of New Testament social history and Roman military history by producing a free online database of all known inscriptions and papyri relating to Palestine, Jews, and Palestinians from the period 63 BCE-136 CE.
